name: Trigger Happy
flavour: May never takes her finger off it.
text: The Tommy Gun never stops firing: a steady stream of two thirds more rounds, each 35% weaker, swaying 12° to either side on its own so it sprays the whole front.
vfx: an unbroken stream of rounds from the companion gun, sweeping slowly left and right across the front
art_prompt: a black tommy gun with a round drum magazine spraying a long unbroken stream of golden bullets, a magenta-gloved finger holding its trigger down
